(ga)༄༅/ /lha mo shra ba ṇa'i sgrub skor bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /mkhyen rab ut+pal rgod pa'i 'dzum phreng rtser/ /snying rje'i bung ba rol pa'i zlos gar

tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// lha mo shra ba ṇa'i sgrub skor bzhugs so// ༄༅// mkhyen rab ut+pal rgod pa'i 'dzum phreng rtser// snying rje'i bung ba rol pa'i zlos gar las// lung bstan sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed pa can// dpal ldan lha mo'i zhabs la gus btud nas// gzhan la lkog tu gyur pa shes bya'i gnas// mngon sum nyid du gsal bar byed pa'i thabs// man ngag rin chen gsal ba'i me long gang*// blo gsal skye bo'i tshogs la sbyin par bya// lha mo shra ba ṇa'i sgo nas rmi lam brtag pa la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas ljon shing gi drung ngam/ brag phug gam/ de ma 'grub kyang mi khyi'i sgra sogs kyis dben pa'i dgon gnas su/ phyag dar dang spos chus chag chag gdab/ gu gul gyis bdug gzhi bdag gtor ma nyi ma sbrel mar gtang*/ de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ swa bhā was stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ rang gi shes pa hūm̐ du bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros te/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rwa ba dang drwa ba/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me 'bar bar bsams te/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ zhes bzlas/ de nas rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig bsgoms te/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros rdo rje sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas rdo rje sems dpa' dang gnyis su med par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab par rdo rje sems dpa'i sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bab pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag

lus thams cad 'od gsal bar bsam/ ngag tu'ang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes nyi ma gcig gnyis brjod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bca' gzhi la rang gi sngas mgor stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bri/ bum par sman bzang po dang*/ zho 'o ma mar 'bru sna dang bcas pa'i chu gtsang gis bkang zhing*/ shing gi yal gas kha brgyan/ steng nas dar sngon po'i gur phub/ mthar mchod pas bskor/ bum pa'i steng du sgrol ma'i sku yod na bzhag rgyun du bzhag rgyu'i dkar gtor gsum yang bsham/ khrus dang gtsang sbra byas lag par me tog gzung*/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ci nus su bya/ gnyis pa sgrub pa la 'jug pa ni/ rang nyid sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan can/ pad+ma dang zla ba la skyil krung gis bzhugs par skad cig gis bskyed/ 'od zer gyis 'jig rten thams cad gsal bar bsgom zhing*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas/ de nas swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i ri rab shar shel/ lho baiḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa/ de'i steng du kha rgyan dpag bsam gyi shing gi lo ma dang*/ me tog gis rgyas par brgyan pa'i ri rab kyi steng du lha mo shra ba ṇa sku mdog sngon po/ sked pa phra ba/ nu ma rgyas pa/ mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i cha lugs can/ ri rab la stegs 'dug gi tshul du bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ phyag gnyis me long rnga yab 'dzin pa/ shes bya thams cad lung ston par bsam/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las lha mo spyan drangs par bsams te/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim/ de nas lha mo shra ba ṇa bdag gi skye ba la sogs pa gang 'dod pa'i don mi bslu bar bstan du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab nas lha mo la me tog phul bar bsams te bum pa'i steng du bzhag de nas yid ma yengs par/ oṃ shra ba ṇa pi shā tsi ni muṇ+ye swā hā/ zhes pa rgyun ldan du bzlas/ khri phrag gcig gi bsnyen pa byas na sa 'og gi gter mthong bar bshad/ de lta bu'i rim pa la 'bad par bya zhing*/ nub mo nyal khar lhag par yang 'bad/ 'dun pa rtse gcig pas lha mo'i pang du mgo bzhag par bsams te/ mgo byang du bstan g.yas 'og tu bcug la nyal/ gnyid du 'gro khar sngags shub bus ci nus su bzlas la/ sems ma yengs pa gal che/ mtshams byed pa'i dus su mi khyi sogs dang mi 'phrad pa byed cing*/ rab tu smyung gnas chig dril/ de ma byung kyang phyi dro'i kha zas spang*/ sha chang sngo tshod sogs kyi rigs dang khyad par du'ang sgog btsong dang la phug mi za/ dus thams cad du bshags pa la 'bad/ thun mtshams su sgrol ma 'don/ gtor ma gcig bla ma dkon mchog dang shra ba ṇa la 'bul/ gcig chos skyong la 'bul/ gcig gzhi bdag la 'bul/ zas bza' ba'i tshe phud bla ma dang shra ba ṇa la 'bul/ rang sgrol ma'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas zas bza' nangs par langs ma thag dang*/ zas zos rjes dang dri chu dor ba'i rjes su'ang chab blang*/ de ltar 'bad na rab zhag gsum/ 'bring zhag lnga/ tha ma zhag bdun nas 'grub ste/ dngos su lung ston pa'am brda'i tshul du byung na dpyad shes par bya'o// ngan na zlog pa'i thabs bstan du gsol zhes 'dri/ dang por don gcig brtag de nas 'ga' yar yang rim pas brtag tshul 'dis skye ba snga phyi tshe ring thung sogs rang gzhan kun gyi don thams cad gsal bar nus te/ 'di las mchog tu gyur pa'i rmi lam sgrub thabs med par bla ma rnams kyis gsungs shing myong bas kyang grub la/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud nas gsungs so// zhag bdun na ma 'grub na grib shas che ba yin pas bshags sdom la 'bad/ lan gsum bskyar na mi 'grub mi srid do// dkor dang grib can gyi zas la 'dzem pa gal che/

rang gzhan legs pa'i lam la 'god pa'i thabs// rmi lam gsal ba'i me long 'od 'bar ba// bla ma'i man ngag ji bzhin brjod pa ni// don gnyer slob ma'i tshogs la phan phyir yin// 'di la nyes dang dri mas gang phog pa// dpal ldan lha mo'i zhabs la bzod par gsol// legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i dge ba des// 'gro kun thar pa'i gling du 'khrid par shog /ces pa 'di ni bla ma'i man ngag ji bzhin du shar dgas po'i paṇ+ḍi ta bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis sbyar ba'o// shu bhaṃ// ༈ /lha mo shra ba ṇa'i sgo nas rmi lam brtag bsgrub bya tshul dus gsum blang dor rab gsal bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ mkhyen bzang ut+pal rgod pa'i 'dzum phreng rtser// snying rje'i bung ba rol pa'i zlos gar las// thub bstan sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed pa can// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// gzhan la lkog tu gyur pa shes bya'i gnas// mngon sum nyid du lta bar byed pa'i thabs// man ngag rin chen gsal ba'i me long gang*// blo gsal skye bo'i tshogs la sbyin par bya// lha mo shra ba ṇa'i sgo nas rmi lam brtag pa la sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su ljon shing gi drung ngam/ brag phug gam/ de ma 'grub kyang khyi sgra sogs kyis dben pa'i dgon gnas su phyag dar dang spos chus chag chag gdab/ gu gul gyis bdug bla bre dang yol ba sogs ci 'byor gyis brgyan/ rang gi sngas mgor stegs bu gru bzhi'i steng du pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri/ de'i dbus su bum par sman bzang po dang*/ 'o ma dang*/ zho mar 'bru sna dang bcas pa'i chu gtsang gis dgang*/ shing gi yal gas kha brgyan/ steng nas dar sngon po'i gur phub/ bum pa'i steng du sgrol ma'i sku yod na bzhag rgyun du bzhag rgyu'i dkar gtor gsum yang bsham/ mtha' bskor chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa mtshams 'dzin me tog dang bcas kyis bskor ba'am/

yang na sbreng tshar du bsham/ sbyin bdag gi ched du yin na de'i dmod 'bru gtsang ma dang*/ rang gi ched du yin na mdun du 'thor nas bshams la me tog 'bul ba'i tshe dmod bor bas 'thus/ gzhan yang rdor dril sogs nyer mkho rnams 'du byas// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ yar ngo'i gza' skar tshes grangs dge bar rdor dkar la gnas pa'i bcad rgya byas la/ mdun gyi mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs/ de nas bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la/ dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa'i skyabs 'gro nyer gcig la sogs pa bya'o// de nas bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgom zlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bsgom/

de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje sems dpa' oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis su med par bsam/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag lus thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥzhes snying po ci nus bzla/ thal mo sbyar te/ bdag gi mi shes rmongs pa ste sogs nas/ dag par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mor gsal ba'i thugs kar pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i tām̐ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya se gol gyi spyan drang*/ thal mo sbyar la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma ār+yā tā rā yai/ zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ ār+yā tā rā ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ du gyur pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur bla bre me 'od dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ zhes phreng skor tsam bzla/ de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid tām̐ yig dkar po de las 'od 'phros/

don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum ma g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ dbu skra mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud ltag par bcings shing*/ lan bu ring du 'phyang ba dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ sku las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gsal bar byed pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i tām̐ yig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya se gol gyis spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang tām̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya se gol gyis spyan drang*/ thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ ār+yā tā rā sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa'i sngags la pra tīts+tsha swā hā btags pas mchod/ thal sbyar ram dril gsil gang rung gis/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tut+tā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res na ba rnams las sgrol// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ rang gi thugs kar tām̐ yig la sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/

don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus rang la thim/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ phreng skor tsam bzlas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim/ sngas mgo'i bum pa/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i ri rab shar shel/ lho bai ḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa/ de'i steng du kha rgyan dpag bsam gyi shing lo ma dang me tog rgyas pa/ ri rab kyi steng dpag bsam gyi shing gi drung du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la lha mo shra ba ṇa sku mdog sngon po sked skabs phra ba/ nu ma rgyas pa/ mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i cha byad can/ ri rab la stegs 'dug gi tshul du bzhugs pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas rnga yab dang me long*/ g.yon dpag bsam gyi shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ shes bya thams cad gsal bar lung ston pa'i skur gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo shra ba ṇa la bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes bsdu rgya se gol gyis spyan drang*/ oṃ gu ru tri rat+na shra ba ṇa ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim pas/ steng gi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par gyur/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs gong bzhin/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs/ tshigs bcad dang spel nas mchod pa'am/ yang na/ oṃ gu ru tri rat+na shra ba ṇa ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs shab+da rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ dril gsil lam thal sbyar gang rung gis/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs bla bstod/

ston pa bla med sogs dkon mchog dang*/ ma rig 'khrul pa'i sems can la// yang dag don rnams gsal mdzad pa'i// rje btsun sgrol ma thugs rje can// shra ba ṇa la phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen las grub ri rab steng*// dpag bsam shing drung pad zla la// khyel stegs tshul gyis rab bzhugs pa// shra ba ṇa la phyag 'tshal lo// in+d+ra nī la'i mdangs ldan sku// mdzes shing rab sgeg yid 'ong ba// dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras// shra ba ṇa la= /phyag g.yas me long rnga yab kyis// shes bya ston cing rmongs pa sel// phyag g.yon dpag bsam yal ga yis// dgos 'dod stsol la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// phrin las gcig bsdus rje btsun mar// bdag gis gus pas bstod pa'i mthus// rab 'byams dus gsum gsal mthong shog /ces bstod la rang gzhan gyi dmod 'bru thal mo'i bar du gzung nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang khyad par bcom ldan 'das ma shra ba ṇas bdag gis yid la re ba'i don 'dis thog drangs dus gsum gyi blang dor thams cad mngon sum bzhin du shes nus pa'i phrin las dang stong grogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod nas rten la me tog gtor/ de 'dra lan nyer gcig nas gsum gyi bar byas la/ sems kyis lha mo shra ba ṇas rang gi yid la yod pa'i don des thog drangs blang dor gsal bar ston par bsams la/ mdun gyi skyabs gnas rnams blo la gsal 'debs ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ oṃ shra ba ṇa pi shā tsi ni muṇ+ḍe swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas/ thun 'phro 'jog pa na'ang gong bzhin 'dod gsol mchod bstod byas la/ gtor ma dang po/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod nas byin gyis brlab/ mdzod rgya'i mthar se gol gtogs la/ oṃ gu ru tri rat+na shra ba ṇa na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥgṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta swā hā/ btags pa gsum gyis bla ma dkon mchog shra ba ṇa la 'bul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo bstod pa 'dod gsol rnams gong bzhin/ gtor ma gnyis pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya se gol rdor thal mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā lī de bī yi/ dharma pā la tsa turmu kha/ karma nā tha sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba sogs btags pa gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ thal sbyar dril gsil gang rung gis/ gang gis 'phrul dang sogs kyis bstod/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma khyed rnams kyis bdag gi yid la re ba'i don 'di sogs gong bzhin phrin las bcol/ gtor ma gsum pa 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs te/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas mdzub mo bkug pa dang*/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum/ rdo rje thal mo se gol dang bcas pas bsngo/ thal mo sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo sogs bzhi dang*/ thal sbyar dril gsil rgyun chags gang rung gis/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi gtso byas pa'i dzam+bu gling gi gzhi yi bdag po rnams dang sogs gtor ma brgya rtsa ji lta bar brjod pa'i mthar/

ru nga dang phrag dog ma mdzad par chos dang mthun pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ khyad par bdag gi yid la re ba'i don 'di sogs gong bzhin phrin las bcol/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ rten yod na/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na oṃ khyed kyis sogs gshegs bsdu/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs go bgo /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun sgrol ma 'grub gyur nas sogs/ rje btsun sgrol ma khyed sku sogs/ khyed la mchod cing sogs bsngo smon ci shes dang*/ ston mchog dam pa lha mis sogs kyis bkra shis bya'o// thun bzhi byed na/ thor thun snga thun dgongs thun gsum la 'di bzhin/ srod thun la bzlas pa'i mchod bstod 'dod gsol rdzogs nas gnyid kyi mtshams sbyar/ tho rangs ldang ba'i tshe gnyid sad pa dang gtor 'bul sogs thun gyi rjes chog rnams byas la thor thun la 'jug de lta bu'i tshul gyis bsnyen pa byed tshul ni/ kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i sha ba ṇa'i sgrub thabs las/ 'di khri phrag gcig bzlas nas bsnyen pa byas na sa 'og gi gter mthong bar bshad pas de lta'i rim pa la 'bad par bya zhing nub mo nyal khar lhag par yang 'bad/ 'dun pa rtse gcig pas lha mo'i pang du mgo bzhag par bsams la mgo byang du bstan/ g.yas 'og tu bcug la nyal/ gnyid la 'gro khar sngags ci nus bzlas/ sems ma yengs pa gal che/ mtshams byed dus mi khyi sogs dang mi 'phrad par byed cing rab smyung gnas chig dril/ de ma grub kyang phyi dro'i kha zas dang*/ sha chang sgog btsong sngo tshod kyi rigs dang*/ khyad par sgog btsong dang la phug mi bza'/ dus thams cad du bshags pa la 'bad/ thun mtshams du sgrol ma 'don zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ zas bza' ba'i tshe phud bla ma dang shra ba ṇa la 'bul/ rang sgrol ma'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas bza'/

nangs par langs ma thag dang*/ zas zos rjes dang dri chu dor ba'i rjes su chab blang*/ de ltar 'bad na rab zhag gsum/ 'bring lnga/ tha ma bdun la 'grub ste/ dngos su lung ston pa'am/ brda'i tshul du gsal bar 'byung*/ gal te mi gsal na bskyar bas gsal bar 'gyur/ brda'i tshul dpyad shes pas ngan na zlog pa'i thabs bstan du gsol zhes 'dri/ dang po don gcig brtag de nas 'ga' yar yang rim pas brtag tshul 'dis skye ba snga phyi dang*/ rang gzhan kun gyi don thams cad gsal bar nus te/ 'di las mchog tu gyur pa'i rmi lam sgrub thabs gzhan med par bla ma rnams kyis gsungs shing myong bas kyang grub bo// 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud nas gsungs/ zhag bdun nas ma 'grub na grib shas che ba yin pas bshags sdom la 'bad/ lan gsum bskyar na mi 'grub mi srid do// dkor dang grib can gyi zas la 'dzem pa gal che'o zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas de bzhin du shes par bya'o// zhes lha mo shra ba ṇa'i sgo nas rmi lam brtag bsgrub bya tshul 'di'ang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis dwags po paṇa chen bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi gsung la gzhi byas/ gong 'og chings rnams rgyud sde dang mi 'gal phyin nyams su blangs bde ba rang gal che bas de bzhin du bsgrigs pa 'di la 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i tshogs cung zad kyang med cing*/ bkras rnam pa'i sgrub thabs su bsnyen pa'i sngon du zhag gnyis gsum tsam gzhi bdag gtor ma dang*/ srung 'khor nan cher bya bar bshad pas/ de dag ni gtor ma brgya rtsa sogs gtor ma rgyas bsdus gang rung dang*/ uṣ+ṇī ṣa dang brag rdzong ma'i srung 'khor gang rung la 'bad na 'thus shing go chod pas sngon 'gro'i tshul du zhag shas de ltar bya/ dngos gzhi'i skabs chos skyong gtor 'bul 'di ni rang gang bsten gyi chos skyong la 'bul ba las gur zhal la nges bzung mi dgos shing*/ chos skyong bsten pa'i dmigs bsal med na rgyal chen bzhi la 'bul bas 'thus pas de ltar shes par bya'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha ba tu//

༈ /lha mo shra ba ṇa'i man ngag gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs snang ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ār+ya tā ra yai/ rje btsun sgrol ma slob dpon dze tā ri// rdo rje gdan pa che chung ba ri ba// kun dga' snying po bsod nams rtse mo dang*// grags pa rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che// ye shes 'byung gnas kun dga' seng ge dang*// seng ge rgyal mtshan bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs// shes rab rdo rje rnams la= /grags pa rdo rje grags pa don grub dang*// ri khrod grub chen bkra shis rnam par rgyal// bde legs bzang po rin chen chos rgyal dang*// shes rab rgyal mtshan rnams la= /don grub rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas rin chen zhabs// bstan 'dzin bzang po ngag dbang lhun grub dang*// rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa gnas gsar ba// kun dga' blo gros rnams la= /chos nyid ye shes nam mkha' 'chi med dang*// byams pa'i thugs rjes mtha' klas 'gro kun la// rmad byung phan bde'i dga' ston sbyin mkhas pa'i// bstan 'dzin mtshungs pa med der gsol ba 'debs// de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// snying nas gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol btab mthus// grangs med sgrib gnyis 'ching ba kun zhi nas// byin rlabs bdud rtsis rtag tu skyong gyur cig /khyad par ye shes lha mo shra ba ṇa'i// mtshan dpe'i sku dang gsung gis dbugs dbyung nas// gzhan la lkog tu gyur pa shes bya'i gnas// mtha' dag mngon sum nyid du mthong bar shog /de la brten nas rang gzhan yid can kun// blang dor gnas la rmongs pa'i mun bsal nas// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i snang ba yis// shis pa'i pad+mo rtag tu rgyas gyur cig /ces pa'ang khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor gyur pa mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin las tshul 'di'i bka' drin thob pa shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa sid+dh+yan+tu//
